critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 860 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into separate router files (auth.py, tasks.py, ai.py, etc.).
Transcribe endpoint correctly short-circuits files < 1024 bytes returning empty text — prevents unnecessary Whisper API calls for silence/noise.
Claude chat uses build_memory_context() which loads up to 500 tasks, 500 expenses, 60 habit-logs, 60 health-logs per request — may become slow/costly at scale. Consider caching or pagination.
